images.description: The weekly setup form where admins enter subject-teacher bindings, each with a type, weekly total and daily-slot cap, above a running 'Total Allocated Hours 42/42' check — the exact input the constraint solver works from, with the 42-hour invariant enforced.
images.altText: PlanIt weekly setup form with subject-teacher bindings totalling 42 hours

images.description: A generated six-day timetable in the tabular grid — every cell a lecture or practical with its teacher, breaks held in place, and two-hour practicals kept whole — the compliant week the solver produces from the bindings in one click.
images.altText: Generated weekly timetable grid of lectures and practicals

images.description: The Auto Schedule dialog listing the rules it enforces — weekly totals, per-day limits, correct lecture/practical types — beside a live timetable preview and a Start Auto-Scheduling button, making the constraint solver's logic visible before it commits a week.
images.altText: Auto-schedule dialog with rules and timetable preview

images.description: The teacher dashboard for Dr. Anil Sharma showing only his day, notifications, his subjects and schedule-change requests — proof the same dataset renders a role-scoped slice, so a teacher sees just his own timetable, not the whole college's.
images.altText: Teacher dashboard showing one teacher's daily schedule

images.description: The admin home summarising teachers, students and subjects with role-distribution and class-distribution charts plus quick actions — the overview an administrator lands on before setting up bindings and generating the week's schedule.
images.altText: Admin dashboard with teacher, student and subject charts

images.description: User management with Teachers, Students and Admins tabs and a table mapping each teacher to the subjects they carry — the backing data for the three-role JWT model that decides which timetable slice each person can see.
images.altText: User management table mapping teachers to subjects

images.description: Class management listing CS-A, CS-B, IT-A and IT-B with student counts, per-class timetable shortcuts and a students-per-class chart — the admin surface for defining the classes each generated weekly timetable is produced for.
images.altText: Class management table with students-per-class chart

images.description: The subjects manager with a searchable table of subject names and codes and a create/edit modal — the basic CRUD catalogue that feeds the subject dropdowns in the weekly setup form; useful but routine administrative plumbing.
images.altText: Manage subjects table with create-subject modal
